title: Meta pushes back on Philippine National ID integration for social media

blocks.text: Meta cites technical complexity for integrating the Philippine National ID for user verification. The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) has urged Meta to integrate the national ID as part of their process for Filipinos to gain access to Meta platforms, which are: Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and Threads. The meeting happened in Singapore. There, DICT Secretary Henry Aguda told Meta about the integration of the Philippine national ID. He cited Roblox was able to promise to do so. Part of the reason to the urge to integrate the national ID is to curb online crime, fraud, and child-safety risks. Meta pointing out technical complexity should not be considered a refusal. But it is a show of reluctance. At the very least, Meta has pushed back on the immediacy and the scope of the integration of the national ID. Meta has, however, committed to send a technical working group to the country to collaborate with National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), and the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) on identity-verification features. The CICC claimed Meta will not receive direct ass to the national ID database. Instead, Meta will be able to send identification or reference number to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), which would only show a "match" or "no match." Personal data would remain with the government.
